tagline: Your teeth deserve better than neglect. We'll prove it.
heroSubtitle: NHS and private dentistry that actually has room for you. From routine check-ups to complex restorative work, we handle it all under one roof—no referrals, no waiting lists.

usps.title: NHS & Private Options
usps.description: We offer both NHS and private dental care, giving you flexibility in choosing your treatment pathway and payment method.

usps.title: Highly Rated Practice
usps.description: Trusted by patients with a 4.8-star rating from 51 reviews, reflecting our commitment to excellent dental care.

usps.title: Comprehensive Treatment Range
usps.description: From routine check-ups and preventative care to advanced restorations, implants, and cosmetic dentistry solutions.

usps.title: Emergency Care Available
usps.description: Need urgent dental treatment? We offer emergency appointments with full treatment included, not just assessment.

usps.title: Modern Technology
usps.description: We use advanced diagnostic tools including digital X-rays and modern techniques like airflow polish for superior results.

usps.title: Convenient Leeds Location
usps.description: Located at 8 Montreal Avenue, Leeds, making quality dental care easily accessible to the local community.

workflow.title: Book Your Appointment
workflow.description: Contact Montreal Dental Care to schedule your examination or emergency appointment. We offer flexible scheduling for routine and urgent care.

workflow.title: Initial Examination & Diagnosis
workflow.description: Arrive for your appointment where we conduct a comprehensive examination, take X-rays, and assess your dental health and any concerns.

workflow.title: Treatment Planning & Discussion
workflow.description: We discuss our findings, explain any issues, provide prevention advice, and outline your treatment options with transparent pricing.

workflow.title: Treatment & Aftercare
workflow.description: Receive your chosen treatment, whether preventative care, restorative work, or cosmetic enhancement, followed by clear aftercare instructions.

faqs.question: Are you accepting new NHS patients?
faqs.answer: We currently have no availability for new NHS patients. However, we do offer comprehensive private dental treatment options for all your dental care needs.

faqs.question: What is included in a Band 1 examination?
faqs.answer: Band 1 (£27.90) includes an examination, diagnosis with X-rays, advice on preventing further problems, a scale and polish if clinically needed, and preventative care such as fluoride varnish application.

faqs.question: What does Band 2 treatment cover?
faqs.answer: Band 2 (£76.60) covers everything in Band 1 plus additional treatment such as fillings, root canal work, and tooth extraction.

faqs.question: Do you offer emergency dental appointments?
faqs.answer: Yes, we offer emergency appointments for £100, which includes full treatment—not just an assessment. This ensures you receive the care you need urgently.

faqs.question: What cosmetic treatments are available?
faqs.answer: We offer tooth whitening from £270, anti-wrinkle injections, lip enhancement, and advanced dermal fillers. Please call us for a full range of cosmetic options and personalised advice.

faqs.question: How much do dental implants cost?
faqs.answer: Dental implants start from £2300. We recommend calling the practice to discuss your specific needs and receive a personalised treatment plan and quote.

reviews.author: Sarah M.
reviews.text: Montreal Dental Care provided exceptional care during my emergency appointment. The team was professional, gentle, and resolved my problem quickly. Highly recommend to anyone in Leeds needing urgent dental treatment.

reviews.author: James T.
reviews.text: Had my routine check-up and scale and polish here. The examination was thorough and the staff explained everything clearly. Great value for money and very welcoming atmosphere.

reviews.author: Emma L.
reviews.text: I chose Montreal Dental Care for my tooth whitening treatment and was very impressed with the results. The team are knowledgeable, friendly, and made me feel comfortable throughout. Will definitely return.

reviews.author: David P.
reviews.text: Excellent private dental practice in Leeds. The staff are professional and attentive, and they offer a wide range of treatments. My filling was done perfectly and the aftercare advice was very helpful.
